newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end higher on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end higher on bargain hunting.

text.p: Thai stocks closed modestly higher on Tuesday as some investors took the opportunity to snap up cheap shares, brokers said.
The SET index closed up 6.04 points at 919.01 with 3.05 billion baht trade. The SET-50 index was up 0.64 points to 69.51.
"There was a mild bargain hunting today as some shares were believed to have hit their support level," said one broker at Ekkapat Finance.
Gainers led losers 175 to 111, while 107 closed unchanged.
Brokers said trading volume remained quiet as the market paid attention on political developments ahead of the general election to be held on November 17.
"I don't think there will be much activity in the market over the next few days as election resutls remain uncertain," said another broker at a foreign house.
Thai Farmers fell one baht to 140 on the most active trade of 166 million baht. Bangkok Bank closed unchanged at 194.
Finance One gained 1.50 to 60 and Dhana Siam Finance rose three to 69.50. Strike-hit Thai Airways ended up 0.50 at 44.50 baht.
